about_the_game:
Hidengen is a multiplayer PvP shooter that blends stealth, parkour, and vertical combat. The action takes place on a mysterious alien planet where a scientific expedition has vanished without a trace. You are a volunteer sent to investigate — but something went terribly wrong. Now, only one can survive, and the evacuation ship has room for just one.

Key Features:

  •  Battle Royale with a twist: A last-player-standing PvP experience with no teams — only one survivor makes it out alive.

  •  Jetpack traversal: Use your jetpack with an overheat system to move quickly and gain vertical advantage. Time your flights carefully.

  •  Stealth and realistic lighting: Hide in shadows, ambush your enemies, and adapt to dynamic lighting that affects visibility and tactics.

  •  Vertical level design: Giant mushrooms, cliffs, and industrial structures create multi-level battlefields. Height is a strategic asset.

  •  Dynamic weather and day-night cycle: Sandstorms, rainfall, snowfall, and transitions from bright daylight to pitch-black night change every match. Adapt on the fly.

  •  Light parkour elements: Climb, slide, and maneuver around the terrain. Mobility gives you an edge.

  •  Win with cunning, not just firepower: Outsmart your opponents. Use the environment and clever tactics to turn the tide.

  •  Short, intense matches: Each game lasts 10–15 minutes. Every choice matters.

There is no between-match progression — all players start equal. Your survival depends entirely on skill, strategy, and adaptability.

 Coming soon: Additional game modes including Deathmatch and Extraction are planned for future updates.
